description: This file implements a TokenManager class for handling OAuth token lifecycle, including obtaining, refreshing, revoking, and storing tokens, within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: TokenManager
classes.description: Manages OAuth tokens including retrieval, refresh, revocation, and storage for the Notesnook application.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current token, optionally renewing if expired or forced.

methods.name: _isTokenExpired
methods.description: Checks if a token has expired based on timestamp and expiry duration.

methods.name: _isTokenRefreshable
methods.description: Determines if a token can be refreshed based on scope and presence of refresh token.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Obtains an access token with specified scopes, renewing if necessary.

methods.name: _refreshToken
methods.description: Performs token refresh using mutex to prevent concurrent refreshes.

methods.name: revokeToken
methods.description: Revokes the current token and deletes it from storage.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Stores a new token response in persistent storage.

methods.name: getAccessTokenFromAuthorizationCode
methods.description: Exchanges an authorization code for a token and saves it.
